Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

We acknowledge your renewal offer, your price freeze and the management approval requirement for larger changes. Please revise the offer to provide a longer contract term, extended payment terms and greater call-off flexibility within your approval authority.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 36 months, 13,740 units in total.
2. Our proposal: option A: EUR 425.71 per unit, 60 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year; option B: EUR 424.29 per unit, 45 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year; option C: EUR 422.87 per unit, 30 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year. Option A amounts to about EUR 5,849,255 over the term.
3. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of one option we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €431.61 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. 

We welcome your commitment to a 36-month contract and have recalculated our proposal based on this extended term. For a volume of 4,580 units per year over 36 months with 30 days net payment, we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 430.15. This reflects the maximum adjustment possible for the extended term, as our base pricing remains strictly constrained.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. 

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

We note your revised offer linking the lower unit price to a shorter payment term and acknowledge that further changes require management or committee approval. We will retain your offered price; please submit our proposal for a longer payment term to the decision-making body, or obtain approval for your best alternative non-price term.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 36 months, 13,740 units in total.
2. Our proposal: option A: EUR 431.61 per unit, 90 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year; option B: EUR 432.05 per unit, 90 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year; option C: EUR 427.29 per unit, 60 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year. Option A amounts to about EUR 5,930,321 over the term.
3. Basis: You write that your base prices are frozen. Our current price is EUR 412.74; EUR 431.61 is an increase of 4.6% on it. Under a price freeze we would expect today's price to continue - our proposal already accepts most of that increase. Our recent orders for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 were at 412.74 per 1 (po:4500014351-10, po:4500014417-10, po:4500014465-10).
4. Next step: We ask you to put this proposal to your pricing committee: a binding 36-month agreement for 13,740 units, about EUR 5,930,321, justifies a decision beyond the standard approval limit. Your base price stays unchanged in option A. On your confirmation of any option we confirm the order in writing the same day, and we pay every invoice on the due date - no further rounds. All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of one option we will issue the order.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.

We have presented your proposal for a 90-day payment term to our management. To accommodate this 90-day payment term for a 36-month contract at 4,580 units per year, we can offer a unit price of EUR 433.08. 

Consequently, our current Angebot comprises a price of €433.08 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
